duration.text: The Chinese Medicine at Beijing University of Chinese Medicine is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Letter of guardian’s guarantee For applicant under 18 years of age Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.A good command of Chinese (reading,oral aural and written) Note: Undergraduate applicants are required to sit for a written Entrance Examination and to be interviewd. Level 6 or above HSK certificate holders are exempt from the Written Examination.
